verified_facts: Composite DTM covers about 99% of England
DTM removes surface objects to represent terrain
source surveys span 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
newest best-resolution survey is used where repeats exist
resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation
vertical accuracy stated as +/-15cm RMSE for LIDAR surveys
persistent WCS endpoint omits release-year suffix
WCS provides raw pixel elevation data
quality_effect: Pins the persistent EA 1m numeric source while preserving composite lineage, interpolation and survey-age limits before any candidate elevation is accepted.
